scenarios.action: create a task with a title and a due date
scenarios.outcome: the task appears in the list under its due date group

scenarios.action: check the checkbox of an open task
scenarios.outcome: the task moves to Completed with a struck-through title
the task returns to Open with its original due date

scenarios.action: filter the list to tasks due today when none are due
scenarios.outcome: the list shows 'No tasks due today' instead of an empty grid

scenarios.action: create a task with an empty title
scenarios.outcome: the create button stays disabled and no request is sent

scenarios.action: complete a task another session already deleted
scenarios.outcome: the stale row is removed from the list and a 'Task no longer exists' note is shown
